IdeoPresetCategoryDef.label: cosmere
IdeoPresetCategoryDef.description: Religions and belief systems from Brandon Sanderson's Cosmere universe. Each ideoligion is based on the faiths of Scadrial, Roshar, and other worlds touched by the Shards.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Steel Ministry
IdeoPresetDef.description: The Lord Ruler is eternal. The nobility are chosen. The skaa are blessed through service. An oppressive theocracy that enforces strict caste divisions and demands absolute obedience to the Sliver of Infinity.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Church of the Survivor
IdeoPresetDef.description: He survived the Pits. He defied the Lord Ruler. He died so we could live. The Church of the Survivor venerates Kelsier as a martyr who gave hope to the oppressed and proved that even gods can fall.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Terris Worldbringers
IdeoPresetDef.description: Knowledge preserved is knowledge eternal. The Worldbringers are keepers of memory and wisdom, trained in the ancient Terris tradition of storing and preserving all knowledge against the darkness.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Survivorism
IdeoPresetDef.description: The Survivor lives. He watches over the forgotten. Survivorism teaches that Kelsier's spirit endures, guiding those who fight against oppression with cunning, defiance, and unbreakable will.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Sliverism
IdeoPresetDef.description: Those who held Infinity walk among us still. Sliverism venerates all who have touched the power of Preservation or Ruin, believing their wisdom transcends mortal understanding.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Trellism
IdeoPresetDef.description: The red star rises. The faceless god approaches. Trellism is a shadowy faith devoted to Trell, whose influence creeps across Scadrial through the Set and other hidden agents.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Jaggenism
IdeoPresetDef.description: The Sovereign came from the north bearing gifts of warmth and life. Jaggenism venerates the masked figure who saved the southern peoples from the cold with the Bands of Mourning.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Pathianism
IdeoPresetDef.description: Harmony guides but does not command. Pathianism teaches that each person must forge their own path while remaining part of a greater community, balancing independence with mutual aid.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Vorinism
IdeoPresetDef.description: The Almighty judges. The Heralds defend. Men prepare for war while women preserve knowledge. Vorinism is the dominant faith of the Vorin kingdoms, teaching preparation for the coming Desolation.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Stone Shamanism
IdeoPresetDef.description: The stone is sacred. To walk upon it is sacrilege. The Shin revere stone as forbidden ground and abhor violence, tending the soil in peaceful Shinovar.

IdeoPresetDef.label: The Passions
IdeoPresetDef.description: Feel deeply. Live boldly. Trade wisely. The Thaylen faith holds that strong emotion is divine, and every passion from love to anger can be sacred when truly felt.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Parshendi Rhythms
IdeoPresetDef.description: The world sings. We listen. The Singers hear the rhythms that permeate Roshar. Each emotion has its own rhythm, and to attune is to touch something eternal.

IdeoPresetDef.label: Yaezirism
IdeoPresetDef.description: Yaezir died a hundred deaths so that mankind might survive, and returned from every one. The Makabaki west venerates the Heralds by name and keeps their accounts as carefully as any other ledger. A petition is written, sealed and filed, because a thing not recorded did not happen.

IdeoPresetDef.label: the Long Trail
IdeoPresetDef.description: The Iriali walk a path that began on another world and does not end on this one. Each stop teaches what it has to teach, and then the people move on. To die here is not to arrive; it is to be counted, and to wait for the rest to catch up.
